title: Mr. Ahmad Ilu
text:
Ahmad Ibraheem Ilu is an Economist and a Policy Researcher at the Nigerian Economic Summit Group (NESG). Ahmad Ilu is passionate on specializing in research on Macroeconomic Models such as DSGE-based models, Financial Economics, Monetary Economics, Applied Econometrics, and Islamic Economics. My extensive knowledge and experience have enabled me to participate in interviews on various live TV programs, where I analyze and discuss contemporary Macroeconomic issues, financial markets, and monetary and fiscal policies. I am proficient in the use of various:
• Document Preparation Software: Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Latex, and R Markdown
• Statistical software tools: (R & RStudio), Python, EViews, STATA, Matlab, and Dynare.
